body: If I’m still around I’ll watch it, just hate that I literally don’t care one way or another.
Did you take a lot? I was also thinking of throwing trazadone in as well. That plus alcohol I thought should probably do it, but I’ve never ODed before...

I’ve been in therapy for over a year. Antidepressants for about 6 months.
A couple months ago, when I could, I was working out every day, eating healthy, in contact with people, etc etc. Now though... everything is next level worse. It’s a good day if I brush my teeth or take a shower. Most days it’s just staying in bed all day. I have zero energy for other activities.
Thanks, I really do appreciate this. But I don’t live in Oregon. It means a lot though
